Goopy Chicken
By: Barnaby Dorfman
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




6 boneless chicken breasts
2 cups cream of chicken soup
1 cup flour
1 tablespoon lemon juice
1 tablespoon poultry seasoning
1/8 teaspoon garlic powder

Preparation

1 Mix flour, poultry seasoning, garlic powder, dip chicken in mixture. Brown chicken in vegetable oil (electric skillet). Place chicken on dish sprinkle with lemon juice, let sit. 2 Combine chicken soup (undiluted) add 2/3 of (one) can of water, mix with wire whisk add leftover flour mixture. Pour this over chicken, cover . Cook in skillet for 1-2 hours. Crock Pot Method: Low 8-10 hrs-high 3-5 hrs
